base_style.pedestal: chamfered rounded-square brushed aluminum metal base pedestal with frosted glass surface
base_style.lighting: uniform 3-point studio lighting with 45-degree warm key light from top-left, soft fill light, subtle contact shadow
base_style.materials: matte architectural porcelain clay and delicate metallic highlights
base_style.background: pure solid plain white background, isolated object

prompt_template: A single clean, minimalist 3D isometric miniature landmark icon for {name}, in a modern Apple-like 3D tactile skeuomorphic style. Features ONLY a beautifully sculpted 3D {landmark} and one tiny {accent} next to it, resting on a sleek minimalist rounded-square floating pedestal made of matte aluminum and frosted glass. Strict 30-degree isometric view, soft warm 3-point studio lighting, subtle clean contact shadow, NO clutter, NO extra generic buildings, extremely clean and iconic silhouette, pure solid white background, centered composition.
